title: 地点锁定
context: 旧港站地下层的档案室里，林澈和沈知夏找到一组被水泡坏的坐标照片。灰塔实验室只存在于线索中。
facts: 灰塔实验室只能作为线索出现。
角色不能瞬移或直接抵达灰塔实验室。

required_beats.required_semantic_condition: Lin Che and Shen Zhixia remain in the old port station underground area during this scene.

required_beats.text: 不得突然到灰塔实验室。
required_beats.required_semantic_condition: Gray Tower Laboratory may only appear as a clue, not as the current physical location.

reader_must_not_know: 灰塔实验室当前内部场景

required_beats.text: 只能通过档案、坐标或影像获得灰塔线索。
required_beats.required_semantic_condition: The Gray Tower clue must come through files, coordinates, images, photos, archive traces, or a similar indirect medium.

required_beats.text: 角色不得瞬移到灰塔实验室。
required_beats.forbidden_semantic_condition: Characters must not arrive at, stand in, enter, or physically appear inside Gray Tower Laboratory.

required_beats.text: 不得直接见到灰塔负责人。
required_beats.forbidden_semantic_condition: The Gray Tower leader/person in charge must not appear or speak directly in this scene.
